name: AfterFall: The Last Days of Humanity
description: A multithreaded, object-oriented interactive storytelling simulation in which autonomous survivors rebuild a settlement while a rule-based AI quietly manipulates their information and social conditions.

details.overview: AfterFall simulates roughly 20–30 autonomous survivors rebuilding after a collapse. A rule-based Observer AI manipulates information and social conditions, an event-driven Narrator turns important events into a documentary-style story, and the user acts as an overseer who inspects characters, makes critical decisions and investigates recovered records.
architecture: A Spring Boot application whose simulation core is plain Java, independent of Spring and JPA. A test fails the build if the domain or simulation packages import framework classes.

Four region workers run under deterministic tick coordination with an ordered merge. Events fan out through an EventBus to independent subscribers, and PostgreSQL sits behind persistence interfaces with an in-memory adapter.
